dialogues.speaker: Yousuke
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Yousuke
dialogues.text: Oh, you must be the traveler that solved the Mikage Furnace incident with Mr. Xavier.

dialogues.speaker: Yousuke
dialogues.text: It's very nice to meet you — I've heard so much about you. I am Yousuke, indeed, and I am currently providing oversight of the Mikage Furnace repair efforts.

dialogues.speaker: Yousuke
dialogues.text: To be honest though, I'm good with crafts and everything, but I'm pretty awful at all the paperwork...

dialogues.speaker: Yousuke
dialogues.text: Still, I will keep at it and hopefully become someone as reliable as Sir Hanbei!

dialogues.speaker: Yousuke
dialogues.text: Hmm? But I heard that Sir Hanbei is well recognized and been tasked with great responsibilities...

dialogues.speaker: Yousuke
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, I will work as hard as I am able. Thank you once again Traveler, for all that you've done for the Mikage Furnace.
